A little about us ✳

Rooted here.
Made to go places.

We believe what you wear can hold a whole lot of meaning.

Meri Blouse Studio is a small PNG fashion business inspired by the colours, creativity and confidence of the women around us. We make pieces that feel special without saving them for a special day.

From choosing a print to the final stitch, every blouse is made with care and a love for the stories our clothes can tell. [Add your founder story, community and craft details here.]
